faqs.a:
Section 701.2. Sewer required,
is hereby amended by adding a second paragraph to read as follows:
"
701.2. Sewer required.
The public sewer shall not be available when such public sewer or any building or
                  any exterior drainage facility connected thereto is located more than 400 feet (121,920
                  mm) from any proposed building or exterior drainage facility on any lot or premises
                  which abuts and is served by such public sewer."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11, 9-14-2020)
